title: Create an interactive interview-pitch website from provided PMO achievements

requirements.text: Create a responsive, single-page website that presents the candidate’s interview narrative with these sections: (1) Executive Pitch, (2) About Me, (3) Four Success Criteria, (4) Impact (Before vs After), (5) 90‑Day Roadmap.

quotes: now i want to present this to the interviwer... total 6 slides.
Now there should be four buttons with four success lines... 5 th button... impact... 6 th butto 90 day roadmap plan

acceptanceCriteria: Landing view includes clearly labeled navigation to: Executive Pitch, About Me, Success Criteria, Impact, 90‑Day Roadmap.
Layout is usable on mobile, tablet, and desktop (no horizontal scrolling; typography scales appropriately).
All user-facing text is in English.

requirements.text: Implement a hero/landing section (“Executive Pitch”) that shows a crisp professional pitch statement and positions the candidate as a problem solver with high impact; include interviewer names (“Sanjeev” and “Martin”) in a subtle, professional way (e.g., “Tailored for Sanjeev & Martin”).

quotes: first slide should a pitch professional up to the mark accurate crisp hitting the correct keywords and liking as per the interviwer.

acceptanceCriteria: Hero section contains one concise pitch paragraph and a clear call-to-action (e.g., “Explore impact”).
Hero section includes “Sanjeev” and “Martin” text somewhere on the page without claiming any personal details about them.
The pitch reads as a PMO/portfolio-governance profile (governance, lifecycle integrity, automation, cross-region alignment).

requirements.text: Add an “About Me” section/page that summarizes the candidate’s 7 years PMO tenure and explicitly aligns to the stated success criteria: transparent & reliable data, governance/process adherence, reduced bottlenecks, improved reporting/automation.

quotes: There should be one page detailing about me exactly position me as how they want what they want is as per atatached.

acceptanceCriteria: About Me section includes: years of experience, core strengths, and a short alignment list referencing the four success criteria.
Content is scannable (headline + bullet points) and visually distinct from other sections.

requirements.text: Create an interactive “Success Criteria” module with 6 buttons/tabs: four success criteria buttons, a 5th button labeled “Impact”, and a 6th button labeled “90‑Day Roadmap Plan”. Each of the four success criteria buttons must expand to show exactly 3 detailed stories in STAR format based on the user-provided achievements.

quotes: Now there should be four buttons with four success lines every button should explain all three activities i mentioned in detailed in STAR format then there should be 5 th button with name impact... then there should be 6 th butto 90 day roadmap plan

acceptanceCriteria: UI shows 6 clearly clickable buttons/tabs; the selected one is visually highlighted.
Each of the four success criteria reveals 3 STAR blocks with headings: Situation, Task, Action, Result.

STAR content matches the user-provided initiatives (demand review globalization, PM training/KT assets, ServiceNow ITAM inventory; resource-first policy, extension governance, compliance improvement; MS Planner visibility, weekly patch cadence, onboarding manuals; PM availability dashboard, resource dashboard, resource-plan automation).
Only one section is expanded/visible at a time (unless explicitly designed as an accordion with clear separation).

requirements.text: Implement the “Impact” view to show before/after results statements summarizing the 12 activities in a systematic, highly visual way (e.g., two-column “Before vs After” cards).

quotes: 5 th button with name impact which will only show the impact or the before after results statements of 12 activities systematically

acceptanceCriteria: Impact view includes at least 12 concise before/after statements derived from the described work (silos→global transparency; Excel→ServiceNow ITAM; 77%→100% compliance; week-late VP updates→real-time; quarterly→weekly patching; etc.).
Impact is presented in a way that is understandable even when skimming (cards, badges, or metrics-style layout).

requirements.text: Implement the “90‑Day Roadmap Plan” view that clearly breaks down Days 1–30, 31–60, 61–90 with concrete, PMO-relevant actions focused on lifecycle integrity, governance control points, automation/validation, dashboards, and enablement/training.

quotes: last slide should be what i will do as my roadmap once i join...
90 day roadmap plan which will showcase my 90 days plan

acceptanceCriteria: Roadmap view shows three time blocks (1–30, 31–60, 61–90) with bullet points.
Roadmap language emphasizes scalable, repeatable systems and governance/data integrity (matching the interview positioning requested).

requirements.text: Use the two uploaded images as reference material and include them on the website in a dedicated “Reference”/“Notes” collapsible section (or modal) without extracting or claiming personal identity details; the section should be optional to view and not dominate the primary narrative.

quotes: The user has uploaded 2 image(s): image.png, image.png.

acceptanceCriteria: A collapsible panel or modal can display the uploaded images.
No text on the site identifies or asserts who is in the images; the images are presented as generic reference notes only.

requirements.text: Establish a coherent, visually appealing design theme (colors, typography, spacing, and component style) that communicates “executive governance / operational excellence”. Do not use a blue+purple palette by default.

quotes: keep it visually appealing even before reading the reader should get to know the impact. keep the reader hooked with visuals.

acceptanceCriteria: Theme is consistent across hero, buttons/tabs, cards, and typography.
Color palette is not blue+purple as the primary combination (unless the user later requests it).
Design remains professional and readable (sufficient contrast; clear hierarchy).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (no additional backend services).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui or other immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT; compose existing UI components instead.
Do not add third-party authentication providers; only Internet Identity is allowed if authentication is later needed.
nonGoals: Building a full CMS or admin panel for editing content.
Integrating external services (ServiceNow, Microsoft Planner, email triggers) beyond static storytelling content.
Automatically generating a downloadable PowerPoint file (the deliverable is a website).

required: Abstract executive governance hero background with subtle grid/lines and warm neutral palette (hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png)
Minimal line-icon set for the four success criteria (governance, data integrity, automation, lifecycle flow) in a cohesive style (success-icons.dim_512x512.png)
